title: Zakarian Organic Red Wine Vinegar, 500ml

comparisons.notes: Exact item: Zakarian Red Wine Vinegar 500ML from Liokareas, the Greek family producer; Shopify product data showed available at $13.99.

writeup: Iron Chef Geoffrey Zakarian's organic red wine vinegar, made from Greek red grapes, comes in a 500ml bottle and is new on Woot for $7.91. Liokareas, the Greek family producer behind it, sells the same bottle for $13.99, so Woot is about 43% less. Woot caps it at 3 per order.
amazon_match_notes: Woot offer page confirms ASIN B08C79HC69 for this item (SKU WT953069A).
